title: ops.round/Tensor.round reject documented nonzero decimals on CPU
duplicate_search_queries: site:gitee.com/mindspore/mindspore "For Round only support decimals equal 0"
site:github.com/mindspore-ai/mindspore "For Round only support decimals equal 0"
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 official ops.round documentation exposes decimals as a keyword argument, describes positive and negative decimals, shows examples for both, and lists CPU as a supported platform.
Tensor.round in the local 2.9.0 wheel refers users to mindspore.ops.round.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the CPU kernel rejects the call before returning a value.
Not a Graph-only issue: PyNative and Graph both fail with the same CPU kernel check.
Not a general CPU unsupported issue: ops.round(x) with decimals=0 succeeds in both modes.
